# Draft:NUMB (X-Dynasty philosophy

NUMB (stylized in uppercase) is a philosophy by Nigerian online streamer and content creator X-Dynasty. The philosophy was founded in mid-2025 by X-Dynasty in a viral livestream after he was bailed from an arrest where he was charged with assault, encouraging followers to develop emotional resilience and stay unshaken amidst life’s challenges.
Release and reception
In 2025, after his bail, X-Dynasty delivered a viral livestream where he introduced the NUMB philosophy, it became the turning point in the streamer’s career in which he started gaining internet relevance and recognition. The NUMB philosophy quickly created a growing cult-like following from viewers who found reliability in his online persona but it was also subjected to critics claiming X-Dynasty is using the philosophy as a content strategy to gain trust from viewers
